title: 2D Contour with an exit point past a rounded corner is refused at the post: the overlap re-cuts the corner arc as chords and the crossing law convicts it

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

A closed 2D Contour with an exit point (#1473) whose overlap runs past a rounded corner generates `ok`, but `verify` blocks it with crossing findings and the post is refused:

```
post: post blocked - 18 warning(s): C1: feed moves 5 and 15 cross in XY at shared depth; C1: feed moves 5 and 17 cross in XY at shared depth; ...
```

## Reproduction (main 4b7a6b1e, `camcraft-cli mcp`)

The part is a 60 × 40 × 10 plate (z 0 to 10) with a 30 × 20 × 5 pocket, as a closed, outward-wound ASCII STL. The outside contour runs at offset 3 with r 3 arcs at the four corners.

```json
[["load_machine", {"builtin": "VMC 3-axis"}],
 ["import_model", {"path": "plate2.stl"}],
 ["set_stock", {"box": {"dx": 70, "dy": 50, "dz": 10}}],
 ["add_tool", {"catalog": "EM-0600-4FL"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "contour", "tool": "EM-0600-4FL", "name": "C1", "source": "plate2",
   "params": {"top_z": {"offset": 0, "reference": "top_of_model"}, "bottom_z": {"offset": -3, "reference": "top_of_model"}, "stepdown": 3,
              "links": {"approach": {"start_point": [30, 0], "exit_point": [0, -20]}}}}],
 ["generate", {"name": "C1"}], ["verify", {}], ["post", {"output": "c1.nc"}]]
```

The moves of the first level, read from the cached toolpath in a throwaway test:

```
  3 Feed (33,8) -> (33,0)                     lead-in to the start point
  4 Feed (33,0) -> (33,-20)
  5 Feed (33,-20) -> (30,-23)  arc c=(30,-20)  first lap: the corner as one arc
  ... the whole ring ...
 12 Feed (33,20) -> (33,0)
 13 Feed (33,0) -> (33,-20)                   overlap toward the exit
 14-27 Feed (33,-20) -> ... -> (30,-23)       the same corner again, as 14 straight chords
 28 Feed (30,-23) -> (0,-23)                  to the exit point's projection
 29 Feed (0,-23) -> (-8,-23)                  lead-out
```

The chords of moves 14–27 lie inside move 5's arc, and the crossing law reads each as crossing it at the same depth.

## Neighbour cases that work (same document)

| Contour | `verify` | Post |
|---|---|---|
| no start or exit point | clean | 67 lines |
| `start_point` [30, 0] only | clean | 67 lines |
| `start_point` [30, 0], `exit_point` [30, −10] (overlap stays on the straight right wall) | clean | 69 lines |
| `start_point` [30, 0], `exit_point` [0, −20] (overlap passes the corner arc) | 18 crossings | refused |

## Root cause (likely)

`crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_start.rs` says it for #1473: "the ring is cut all the way round, then on along its own polyline to the pick's projection". The first lap reaches the post arc-fitted (move 5 is one arc). The overlap is the ring's raw polyline (the 14 chords). Verify law (a) (`crossing`) then sees chord against arc at shared depth.

An overlap on straight segments only, which repeats exact segments, is not flagged. This is read from the moves above; the fitting call was not traced.

## Expected

The overlap to an exit point re-cuts the ring along the same moves the first lap used (the same arcs), so the program verifies and posts like the start-point-only contour. The overlap must not be refused for re-tracing its own wall.

## Suggested labels

Outside contributors can't set labels, so these are suggestions:

- `P3`: a legal program refused. Putting the exit on the start's own edge works around it.
- `effort:high`
- `area:2d`
- `source:agent`

Related: #1473 (start and exit points), #1448.
